headline: CrowdStrike Agrees to Acquire Zscaler for $44 Billion in All-Stock Deal
summary: CrowdStrike has agreed to acquire cybersecurity competitor Zscaler in an all-stock transaction valued at $44 billion. The transaction marks the largest ever merger in the cybersecurity sector.
why: CrowdStrike and Zscaler are major US-based cloud security providers offering endpoint protection and zero-trust network access solutions.
